sentences.text:
The petitioner who is the victim has filed the present petition seeking leave to appeal against the judgment dated 08.04.2022 whereby the respondents were acquitted for the offences under Sections 109/376/376D/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2.

In terms of proviso to Section 413 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (erstwhile Section 372 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973), the victim is not required to seek leave in case aggrieved by the acquittal of the accused and can maintain an appeal against the order of acquittal.
3. In view of the above, the present petition is treated as a Criminal Appeal and the appeal is directed to be numbered as CRL. A............(to be numbered).
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 10/10/2025 at 23:51:58 Criminal Appeal ............/2025 (to be numbered)
4. Let Trial Court record be requisitioned before the next date of hearing.

5. Respondent Nos. 2 to 4 shall furnish bail bond in the sum of 10,000/- with one surety of the like Xxxxx vs The State Of Nct Of Delhi & Ors on 8 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/57792718/
1 amount, to the satisfaction of the Joint Registrar (Judicial).
6. List before Joint Registrar (Judicial) on 15.10.2025.
7.
